description: A contemporary residential exterior photographed at standing eye-level, capturing the ground-floor terrace facade of a two-story modernist house at dusk. The building's exterior is a smooth white stucco render with clean sharp edges, punctuated by large black powder-coated steel-framed sliding glass doors and floor-to-ceiling window systems. The upper level is almost entirely glazed — a continuous band of black-framed multi-pane windows wraps the full width of the second floor. The lower level facade has a wide sliding glass door system spanning three panels at center, revealing a warm interior where amber light reflects off a sleek countertop surface. A second glass door opens to the right, framing a deeper interior space. Two matte black linear wall-mounted elements are positioned flanking the glass openings, each emitting a warm amber vertical stripe of light that washes the white stucco wall surface with a crisp, directional warm glow on either side. The terrace paving is a wide-plank composite deck in warm grey tones. Small round white planters hold compact evergreen shrubs at the base of the facade. The sky above is a deep twilight blue-grey, providing maximum contrast against the warm amber glow of the wall illumination and the warm tones reflected in the glass. The overall palette is white stucco, matte black framing, warm amber illumination, and cool twilight sky. The mood is clean, architectural, and quietly dramatic. Camera is at standing height, using a normal-to-wide lens, with a three-quarter view of the facade looking slightly toward the right corner of the building.
